accepted_a2_1b.entry_contract: H1 v1 remains unchanged; H1 v2 adds source-native observations outside canonical items; each H1 artifact has one top-level source contract; Result V3 accepts H1 v1 or v2; MCP remains six tools.

current_cardinality.request_surface: One requested trading_status_context data_need is represented per target in the request.
current_cardinality.operation_binding: LineageMap.bindings is target_id -> data_need -> one OperationBinding. A second plan operation for the same target/data_need raises duplicate_binding (scripts/m8r_05c/lineage_resolver.py).
current_cardinality.typed_artifact_per_binding: The current lineage resolver permits at most one selected H1 typed artifact in a binding; a second H1 v1/v2 artifact raises duplicate_phase_h_typed_artifact.
current_cardinality.result_cardinality: TargetEvidenceProjection.trading_status_context is one dict-or-null; Result V3 projects one value into that target field (scripts/m8r_05c/models.py and result_builder.py).
current_cardinality.source_cardinality: Each accepted H1 v1/v2 source artifact has one top-level source object. The H1 v2 acceptance explicitly preserves one source contract per artifact.

attention.basis: Current catalog, routing, executor registry, and accepted H-ACT-H1 ledger identify this as the only active H1 route. Preserve its H1 v1 output behavior.

disposition.basis: PR #303 records official fields and a dormant normalizer, but runtime/live value contract verification and route activation have not occurred.

cmode.marker: SuspensionOfTrading=Ｙ (U+FF39); official affirmative marker semantics remain unverified by S2D
cmode.h1_representation: H1 v2 native_observations is accepted and preserves semantic_status=unresolved
cmode.basis: Source identity, license, payload shape, date precedent, and native-only representation are accepted; deterministic adapter and separate activation gate remain outstanding.

suspend_resume_history.role: bounded historical event evidence; not current tradeability proof
suspend_resume_history.basis: May remain optional historical support; full date/calendar grammar, lifecycle, retention, and revision semantics are not established.

A_result_level_component_composition.reason: Preserves one public data_need, one target-level logical operation, one-source-per-H1-artifact, independent component provenance/failure, and the single Result target field while adding an explicit higher-level composition contract.

B_multiple_operations_same_target_need.reason: Conflicts with current target/data_need -> one binding invariant. Supporting it would require coordinated changes to planning, control/approval, operation identity, aggregation, lineage, Result and Audit, and would increase authorization ambiguity. Do not weaken duplicate_binding or duplicate typed artifact protections as a shortcut.

C_multi_source_h1_artifact.reason: Would contradict the accepted A2.1B one-source-per-H1-artifact contract and blur source-specific authority, coverage, dates, citations, hashes, and failures.

D_result_attention_but_other_evidence_on.reason: Would keep disposition/cmode facts outside the canonical Result evidence field, making the Result incomplete for readers and separating conversational facts from the normal persisted/readback surface.

selected_architecture.layer: Higher-level Result projection/composition over independently source-bound H1 component artifacts, coordinated by one explicitly selected composite executor/operation for the predeclared representative source set.
component_requirements: retain each component's source identity, H1 schema version, target, status, coverage, observed/source dates, canonical items or native observations, citations, and artifact identity/hash independently
one component per predeclared source contract; reject duplicate source/component and duplicate artifact identities
all components bind to the same exact canonical target and requested data_need
preserve H1 v1 attention output without migration
selected_architecture.aggregate_coverage: Union only canonical covered_status_types from source-valid components. Native observations do not contribute a canonical subtype; unresolved tpex_cmode SuspensionOfTrading=Ｙ leaves suspension uncovered.
selected_architecture.aggregate_status: Keep a status/outcome on every source component. The composite remains partial while representative canonical scope or the five-type H1 scope is incomplete; component source_failed, binding_failed, no_evidence_in_covered_scope, unsupported, and successful partial outcomes remain distinguishable. Never infer complete/available solely from all configured requests having returned. If no usable component evidence remains, the aggregate may report failure while retaining every component failure detail.
selected_architecture.failure_independence: Failure of one component cannot erase another component's valid evidence. A failed or unmatched component is represented with its own status, source, coverage, and failure reason alongside successful/partial components.
selected_architecture.semantic_guard: Composition cannot add semantics absent from components: native Ｙ is not suspension; absence is not normal; history resumption is not current tradeability; partial components are not complete H1 coverage.

integration_impacts.lineage: Future explicit component group/binding support is required. Keep current duplicate_binding and duplicate_phase_h_typed_artifact failures for ordinary bindings. Resolver must collect only the predeclared source-specific artifacts authorized for the one composite operation, validate target/source/hash/citation alignment, and return a typed component set rather than an arbitrary first artifact.
integration_impacts.operation_bundle: Current operation-result v2 has one operation-level evidence_contract and counts primary artifact item_count values; it requires each primary artifact contract to match the operation contract. Future work must explicitly model one composite primary result plus independently source-bound H1 component artifact references/payloads, without mislabeling H1 evidence or changing legacy item_count semantics. Native observations remain separately counted from canonical items.
integration_impacts.result_v3_impact: ADDITIVE_RESULT_V3_COMPOSITION_BRANCH_REQUIRED. The current Result V3 trading_status_context union accepts H1 v1/v2 only. A future dated current authority must add the composite contract branch and record new hashes; do not change Result V3 in A2.2. Result V4 is not indicated by a demonstrated incompatibility.
integration_impacts.audit_v3_impact: Audit V3 schema can remain unchanged in principle: its evidence_artifact_references and source_attempts arrays can record separate capability/schema_version/path/hash and source attempt lineage for each component. Future builder/loader mappings and exact one-to-one attempt/reference validation must be extended and tested.
integration_impacts.ai_handoff_impact: Render each source component separately with its own status, source/citations, dates, coverage, and caveat. Render cmode's raw Ｙ with semantic_status=unresolved and an explicit no-normalization guard; never flatten components into one status sentence.
integration_impacts.mcp_impact: Existing market_read_result and market_export_ai_handoff carry the Result/Markdown; no seventh tool is needed. Preserve exactly six tools and public tool schemas unless a separately evidenced contract blocker arises.
integration_impacts.planner_and_routing: Prefer one composite executor for one trading_status_context operation, with a fixed source set and exact component execution plan. Do not add parallel bindings for the same target/data_need. Existing attention route remains valid and emits H1 v1; future composite support must accept heterogeneous H1 v1/v2 components.
integration_impacts.network_authorization: Preview/approval/execution must bind the exact ordered source-contract set, official endpoint per component, exact target, TLS policy, timeout, response-byte bound, per-source request budget, retry count, redirect/fallback policy, and expected evidence contracts. No dynamic LLM-selected URL/source. A generic approval must not authorize sources outside the displayed predeclared set.
integration_impacts.deterministic_identity: Bind composition identity to canonical target, requested data_need, composition contract version, ordered predeclared source-contract set, and each component artifact identity/hash. Exclude absolute paths, host/machine name, wall-clock formatting, and UI labels.

static_fixture_results.method: Ephemeral in-memory model of the proposed composite component invariants; no production files or schemas changed.
static_fixture_results.C1_all_required_components_succeed: PASS; component outcomes retained, aggregate canonical coverage is attention+disposition only, native unresolved cmode does not cover suspension, aggregate remains partial.
static_fixture_results.C2_one_component_source_failed: PASS; attention available, disposition source_failed, and cmode native partial remain independently visible.
static_fixture_results.C3_no_matching_disposition_evidence: PASS; the source component records successful bounded retrieval with no exact-target row as component-local no-match while its H1 status remains partial. Do not emit H1 no_evidence_in_covered_scope because that status requires complete five-type H1 coverage.
static_fixture_results.C7_same_artifact_reused_twice: PASS; rejected by duplicate artifact identity.
